scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/aemcors/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/aemcors
  set jcr:title{String} to "AEM Cloud Cors"
end
create service user aemcors-content-service with forced path system/cq:services/aemcors

set ACL for aemcors-content-service
  allow jcr:read on /content
  allow crx:replicate on /content
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow crx:replicate on /content/dam
end
